input_messages.content: Hi, I’m having trouble with my mobile data. It either stops working or is extremely slow, and I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone. I don’t have access to Wi-Fi, so I need this fixed as soon as possible. Can you help?
Sure, my name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information.
Yes, please go ahead and check the network status. Let me know what you need me to do next.
Yes, I confirm. You have my permission to run the network status check on my phone.
It looks like my phone is currently in Airplane Mode, which might be why I’m not getting any service. What should I do next?
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode. My status bar now shows a poor signal with 2G, data is enabled, and data saver is on. What should I do next?
Yes, please guide me through changing the network mode to 4G/5G preferred and turning off Data Saver mode. I want to make sure I get the best possible internet speed.

I’ve set my network mode to 4G/5G preferred and turned off Data Saver mode. My status bar now shows excellent signal strength with 5G, data enabled, and Data Saver is off. What should I do next to check if my internet speed is excellent?
I tried running a speed test, but it failed and said "No Connection." Even though my status bar shows excellent 5G signal, it seems like there’s still no internet connection. What should I do next?
My status bar shows that mobile data is enabled, and I have an excellent 5G signal. What should I try next since the speed test still failed with "No Connection"?
My current APN name is set to "internet" and the MMSC URL is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." Are these settings correct, or should I make any changes to fix my mobile data issue?
Yes, please guide me through resetting my APN settings and rebooting my device. I want to make sure everything is set up correctly so I can get excellent internet speed.

I followed your instructions to reset the APN settings and reboot my device, but when I tried running the speed test again, it still failed with "No Connection." What should I do next? This is getting a bit frustrating since I really need excellent internet speed.

I turned on data roaming as you suggested, but the speed test still fails with "No Connection." I’m still unable to get any internet access, even though my status bar shows excellent 5G signal and data is enabled. What should I try next?

I’d like to clarify: will paying this bill definitely restore my internet connection and give me excellent speed? I want to be sure this will fix the issue before making a payment, since I absolutely need excellent internet speed and nothing less.
Yes, please send me the payment request for the overdue bill. I’ll pay it right away so we can see if that resolves the issue and restores excellent internet speed.
It looks like I haven’t received a payment request yet. Could you please send the payment request so I can proceed with the payment?
I’ve completed the payment for the overdue bill. What should I do next to check if my internet connection and speed are restored?

I paid the bill and tried running the speed test again, but it still fails with "No Connection." My internet is still not working, and I’m not getting any speed at all. What else can we try? I really need excellent internet speed.

I’ve already rebooted my device once after resetting the APN settings, but I can try rebooting again if you think it might help. Please let me know if there’s anything specific I should do during the reboot, or if you want me to just restart the phone as before.

I restarted my phone as instructed, but the speed test still fails with "No Connection." My internet is still not working at all. Can you please escalate this to a human agent? I really need this fixed so I can get excellent internet speed.
###TRANSFER###

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.
